title: Further Studies
notes: This further-studies catalog is dense, law-positive, and free of presenter staging or AI register. Teasers stay short and assert the symbol claims without hedging. The vineyard entry packs too many definitions into one sentence and should split at the evidence-to-assembly seam. The remnant line uses a spelled-out count that house style wants as digits. The weeping line’s reduced relative is grammatical but slightly clipped. TimeTested.Bible appears in body prose; the chapter’s sole purpose is the digital pointer, so the placement is left alone.

proposals.old: Isaiah decoded the vineyard himself — __“the vineyard of the LORD of hosts is the house of Israel”__ — and the remaining symbols are defined too: the wall is __“Salvation,”__ the tower is what a Name builds, the husbandmen are __“the builders,”__ and the owner's repeated verb, __“sent,”__ is the very name of Siloam, whose tower fell on the generation that refused the Sent One.
proposals.new:
Isaiah decoded the vineyard himself — __“the vineyard of the LORD of hosts is the house of Israel”__ — and the remaining symbols are defined too.
The wall is __“Salvation,”__ the tower is what a Name builds, the husbandmen are __“the builders,”__ and the owner's repeated verb, __“sent,”__ is the very name of Siloam, whose tower fell on the generation that refused the Sent One.
proposals.summary: Split the long vineyard sentence at the definition seam.
proposals.rationale: One sentence carries the Isaiah quote plus four symbol definitions; house style prefers splitting evidence-to-assembly seams so the list remains scannable.

proposals.old: The count printed in this book compresses a fifteen-line study — the gleanings, the field's geometry, the gold assay, the lion's census — published complete as “Last Call Before the Fall.”
proposals.new: The count printed in this book compresses a 15-line study — the gleanings, the field's geometry, the gold assay, the lion's census — published complete as “Last Call Before the Fall.”
proposals.summary: Use digits for the line count.
proposals.rationale: House style requires numbers as digits for counts; fifteen is a count of lines.

proposals.old: Jesus says *the* weeping and *the* gnashing — the scene Psalm 112:10 wrote: the wicked sees, gnashes, and melts away.
proposals.new: Jesus says *the* weeping and *the* gnashing — the scene that Psalm 112:10 wrote: the wicked sees, gnashes, and melts away.
proposals.summary: Restore the relative pronoun for the Psalm clause.
proposals.rationale: The reduced relative is grammatical but clipped; inserting “that” clarifies the link without changing meaning or density.
